objects.name: xp_src
objects.ddl: CREATE DATABASE `xp_src` /*!40100 DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin */

objects.name: a_lines
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `a_lines` (
  `order_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `line` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`,`line`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_lines_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: customers
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL COMMENT 'login ação',
  `name` varchar(80) CHARACTER SET latin1 COLLATE latin1_swedish_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `referrer_id` int(10) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `created` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '0000-00-00 00:00:00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_email` (`email`),
  KEY `k_ref` (`referrer_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_referrer` FOREIGN KEY (`referrer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin COMMENT='Customer accounts; ünïcode'

objects.name: departments
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `departments` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `head_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_head` (`head_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_dept_head` FOREIGN KEY (`head_id`) REFERENCES `employees` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: employees
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `employees` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `dept_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_dept` (`dept_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_emp_dept` FOREIGN KEY (`dept_id`) REFERENCES `departments` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: gen
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `gen` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `a` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `b` int(11) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (`a` * 2) VIRTUAL,
  `c` int(11) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (`a` + 1) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: hist
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `hist` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `v` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin WITH SYSTEM VERSIONING

objects.name: logs
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `logs` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `at` date NOT NULL,
  `msg` varchar(200) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`,`at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin
 PARTITION BY RANGE (year(`at`))
(PARTITION `p2025` VALUES LESS THAN (2026) ENGINE = InnoDB,
 PARTITION `pmax` VALUES LESS THAN MAXVALUE ENGINE = InnoDB)

objects.name: orders
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `customer_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `total` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `note` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `currency` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_customer` (`customer_id`),
  FULLTEXT KEY `ft_note` (`note`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: plain_myisam
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `plain_myisam` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `txt` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: ticket
objects.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `ticket` (
  `id` bigint(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval(`xp_src`.`seq_ids`),
  `qty` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `k_qty` (`qty`) IGNORED,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_qty` CHECK (`qty` >= 0)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_bin

objects.name: v_big
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`%` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `xp_src`.`v_big` AS select `v_orders`.`id` AS `id`,`v_orders`.`email` AS `email` from `xp_src`.`v_orders` where `v_orders`.`total` > 1000

objects.name: v_bigger
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`%` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `xp_src`.`v_bigger` AS select `b`.`id` AS `id` from (`xp_src`.`v_big` `b` join `xp_src`.`v_orders` `o` on(`o`.`id` = `b`.`id`))

objects.name: v_orders
objects.ddl: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`root`@`%` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `xp_src`.`v_orders` AS select `o`.`id` AS `id`,`c`.`email` AS `email`,`o`.`total` AS `total`,`f_double`(`o`.`total`) AS `dbl` from (`xp_src`.`orders` `o` join `xp_src`.`customers` `c` on(`c`.`id` = `o`.`customer_id`)) where `o`.`total` > 10

objects.name: seq_ids
objects.ddl: CREATE SEQUENCE `seq_ids` start with 100 minvalue 1 maxvalue 9223372036854775806 increment by 10 cache 1000 nocycle ENGINE=InnoDB

objects.name: p_touch
f_double
objects.ddl:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` FUNCTION `f_double`(x INT) RETURNS int(11)
    DETERMINISTIC
RETURN x * 2

objects.name: pkg_util
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER="root"@"%" PACKAGE "pkg_util" AS FUNCTION f1 RETURN INT; END

objects.name: pkg_util
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER="root"@"%" PACKAGE BODY "pkg_util" AS FUNCTION f1 RETURN INT AS BEGIN RETURN 2; END; END

objects.name: trg_au
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER="root"@"%" TRIGGER trg_au AFTER UPDATE ON customers FOR EACH ROW SET @last = "changed"

objects.name: trg_bi
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` TRIGGER trg_bi BEFORE INSERT ON orders FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.total = ROUND(NEW.total, 2)

objects.name: trg_bi0
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` TRIGGER trg_bi0 BEFORE INSERT ON orders FOR EACH ROW SET NEW.currency = UPPER(NEW.currency)

objects.name: ev_cleanup
objects.ddl: CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`%` EVENT `ev_cleanup` ON SCHEDULE EVERY 2 DAY STARTS '2030-01-01 00:00:00' ON COMPLETION PRESERVE DISABLE DO DELETE FROM logs WHERE at < '2000-01-01'
